issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses thresholds of 7,500 (einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500). This numeric mismatch causes the reference solution to produce a different result set than specified, which will confuse students and make automated checks inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution_query in solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to use the correct thresholds (75000) in the WHERE clause: WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000. Ensure any tests or example data/comments also reflect the 75,000 threshold.
